name: FuseTwo Conversion Tracking
author: fusetwo

sections.description:
FuseTwo Conversion Tracking integrates WooCommerce with the FuseTwo affiliate platform. We employ a “one-roof” approach that enables us to work with over 10K advertisers across 65 networks and over 75K publisher programs. Become one of the many affiliate partners we assist in achieving unlimited strategic growth.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.3 or later
  • WooCommerce
  • A FuseTwo advertiser account

About

The extension works by appending our sale attribution technology onto your shop website and populating the relevant dynamic variables required to record conversions for your affiliate programme. Use of the FuseTwo extension will not change the appearance of your e-commerce site.

To use this extension you must have a FuseTwo advertiser account, please contact our sales department for further information if you wish to join as an advertiser. Additional fees apply.

Features

  • Integrates WooCommerce with the FuseTwo affiliate platform.
  • Sends completed order information for affiliate conversion tracking.
  • Supports MasterTag tracking.
  • Supports Server-to-Server (S2S) tracking.
  • Supports Product Level Tracking (PLT) for product-level reporting.
  • Records conversion information for reporting within your FuseTwo account.
  • Does not modify your storefront or checkout pages.

Privacy

For the purpose of attributing sales and commissions to publishers, FuseTwo will process checkout information including the order reference. This data will be sent and processed on the track.fusetwo.com domain. Any queries regarding the processing of this data can be directed to your dedicated integration contact. Please also see our [privacy policy.] https://www.fusetwo.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin
  2. Click on Settings
  3. Login with your FuseTwo credentials
  4. Click on Install
  5. Done
